name: LangSmith
desc: Tracing, evaluation and monitoring for LLM apps
desc_zh: LLM 应用的追踪、评测与监控平台
solves: An agent breaks on real traffic and the log says nothing. LangSmith keeps every step, then scores what came out.
solves_zh: Agent 在真实流量下才崩，日志里什么也看不到。LangSmith 记下每一步，再给输出打分。
best_for: When a chain only misbehaves in production and the trace is the only lead.
best_for_zh: 链路只在生产环境出问题，trace 成了手上唯一的线索。
notes: 官网已确认，标题「LangSmith: Agent & LLM Observability Platform」。为托管 SaaS（有免费额度，另提供自托管部署选项），form 记为 web。
